name: mw-grafana-events
description: Private owner-authenticated connection to MW Credit Grafana alert history and bridge health. Event delivery requires separate approved activation.

interface.longDescription: Connect to the existing MW Credit monitoring bridge using Google sign-in restricted to the configured owner. Read bridge health and previously accepted sanitized alert events. The server also implements MCP Events, but subscriptions and outbound event delivery remain blocked until separately approved host callback setup and alert routing activation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the monitoring bridge health and help me inspect a known alert event.
